observations: Three photos show a white Sharp AR-M207 multifunction printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
The brand 'SHARP' and model 'AR-M207' are visible on the front panel in photo 0 and photo 1.
The device is shown stacked on top of other printers or boxes.
The top surface of the machine is covered by plastic wrap, obscuring the scanner glass and control panel.
The 'digital' logo is visible on the side in photo 1.
The machine is sitting on a wooden pallet.

claims.claim: AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: The functions are not visible through the plastic wrap.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or print.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine booting up and printing a test page.

risks.risk: The scanner glass may be scratched or dirty.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the scanner glass without plastic wrap.

risks.risk: The internal drum and toner may be empty or expired.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridge tray with the toner level indicator visible.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a drum and toner replacement

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the scanner glass without the plastic wrap.
Photo of the toner cartridge tray to check the toner level.
Photo of the control panel showing the machine is powered on.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
